test_title: PYST 74: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people G, H, I, Q, R and S are sitting in a straight line facing the north. Only two people are seated to the left of G. Only two people are seated between G and I. Only one person is seated between I and R. Q is seated to the immediate left of H. How many people are seated to the right of S?
solution:
Given: Six people Q, H, G, R, S and I are sitting in a row facing north.

Only two people are seated to the left of G.

Only two people are seated between G and I.

Only one person is seated between I and R.

Q is seated to the immediate left of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15e52a9fbbc8d43436fef1b2f816da2111ad90504347640b4715e18a479f9d8e.png] 

Now, people to the right of S = I → 1 person

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
